title: RedX shows its own logo
problem: RedX showed two letters in a red square instead of its logo.
now: RedX shows its own logo in Connections, Payouts and delivery settings.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
